result.title: Bakery Website Project Milestones

milestones.title: Homepage and Menu Mockup Approval
criteria: Deliver high-fidelity mockups for homepage and menu pages.
Client confirms visual design direction and content placement.
All assets are organized in the agreed-upon file repository.

milestones.title: Responsive Site Build Completion
criteria: Develop fully responsive HTML/CSS/JS code for all pages.
Implement functional order form with basic validation logic.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility on desktop and mobile devices.

milestones.title: Deployment Documentation and Handoff
criteria: Provide step-by-step deployment guide for hosting environment.
Conduct live walkthrough session to demonstrate site features.
Transfer all source code, assets, and documentation to client.

risk: Medium value: keep each milestone under ~40% of the total.
